target_days.source: User statement: 'it should survive a long weekend'.

runtime.duty_description: Deep sleep almost all the time. A few short Wi-Fi wakes an hour, plus a couple of minutes of active screen and keypad use a day.

must_fit.source: Calipers across a jacket pocket opening, 2026-09-18.
must_fit.reason: It has to go in a pocket or it will not get carried.

must_fit.source: Comparison against a phone that is comfortable to hold.
must_fit.reason: Above this it stops being a one-handed device.

temp_min_c.source: Carried outdoors in winter but not left out.

temp_max_c.source: Left in a warm room, not a car.

range_target_m.how_to_close: Range-test in place, inside the closed shell.

interactions.notes: Behind an I2C expander, because there is no free ADC1 channel for a resistor ladder.
2.9 inch e-paper. Retains its image with no power, which is exactly why a static demo image proves nothing.
A loud alert tone independent of the amplifier rail.

non_goals: No PCB. This is modules and dev boards joined by wire.
No cellular. Wi-Fi and possibly LoRa only.
